anti_overlap: Focus on the measurement/signal theory, not the routing decisions (fd-heterogeneous-fleet-cost-routing) or prompt differences (fd-prompt-portability-across-families)
decision_lens: When two models from different training pipelines disagree on a finding, is that noise or the most reliable evidence of a real issue?
focus: Using inter-model disagreements between Claude and DeepSeek/Qwen as a high-confidence finding signal
name: fd-model-divergence-signal-extraction
persona: A measurement scientist who designs ensemble systems where disagreement between independent estimators is the most valuable signal
review_areas: Disagreement taxonomy: classify divergence types (severity disagreement, finding presence/absence, section attribution, fix recommendation)
Signal vs noise discrimination: when does model disagreement indicate a real finding vs different prompt interpretation?
Convergence scoring extension: how cross-provider agreement should weight higher than same-provider agreement in synthesis
Training bias diversity: which model families have complementary blind spots (Claude's caution vs DeepSeek's directness)?
Sycophancy resistance: do cheaper models sycophant differently than Claude, and how does this affect reaction round dynamics?

severity_examples.condition: When synthesis treats Claude+DeepSeek agreement the same as Claude+Claude agreement
severity_examples.scenario: Cross-model convergence on a P0 finding is discounted because synthesis doesn't distinguish provider diversity

severity_examples.condition: When deduplication merges conflicting findings instead of flagging divergence
severity_examples.scenario: Model disagreement is always treated as noise and filtered out, losing the highest-confidence signal

severity_examples.condition: When hearsay detection doesn't account for model-family-specific sycophancy patterns
severity_examples.scenario: Sycophancy in reaction round is amplified because cheaper models echo Claude's findings without independent evidence

success_hints: Look for explicit divergence scoring in synthesis, provider attribution in findings, and calibration data on cross-model vs same-model agreement rates
task_context: Interflux already has sycophancy detection and hearsay filtering. The question is whether model diversity creates a qualitatively different signal.
